## Landed · 2026-11-16T04:22Z

PR #34246 merged as `d8a55d64` (ACCEPT 6905710576; contract review PASS 6905440506). The scenario runner now runs `security-rollup-source-unreadable` (`@objectstack/lint`'s `validateRollupSourceVisibility`) on every built artifact (scratch, its iterate, template's iterate), never on the bounded `os build` tail. A finding on a card persona's own set, where the card withholds the roll-up's child object or the named child field from that persona, is one failed Build check, a Build finding naming the persona, the roll-up and the withheld child, and a failing `rollup-source-unreadable:<persona>:<parent.field>` check in the record; `buildPassed` refuses such a build, so template and ask modes do not install it. Other findings are not charged; ask mode is never charged; a build with no such finding is unchanged. On eval#1's live records it charges `project_with_tasks` 9 of 28 scratch builds and invoice 1 of 28 (crm 0), and flips 4 pass verdicts. This settles the maintainer's 「改为搭建侧处理」 on the Build side. `pm:dispatched` dropped; card thread closing. Queue ① is done, and M2 closes with this card.
